title: A road trip in manageable stages
description: Plan stops and overnight stays day by day, account for the vehicle’s requirements and check road restrictions separately.

blocks.text: When adding stops, a road tripper wants a sequence that can actually be driven day by day. Automatic bouncing between the start and the end of the route forces the planning to start over.

quote.text: It can’t even logically order your waypoints. I did a start point in WA and a destination in CA. As I added stops it had me bouncing back and forth between WA and CA

blocks.text: The person sets the start, the finish, the required stops and the overnight stays. A new point can be inserted into a chosen day, the order compared, and the extra time made visible.
What decides whether it is useful

The first thing to test is an ordinary route with several changes. If the product claims to pick roads for an RV, it will need reliable data on vehicle restrictions; a geographically short line does not provide that.
